name: Seat-based MVP smoke eval set
description: Minimal, checked-in golden eval set for the Mason upsell_ranker pipeline. One self-contained conversation that exercises the warehouse-profiling + signal-objective reasoning the dryfit `posthog_seat_based_mvp` scenario plants, WITHOUT requiring the live PostHog warehouse or Inspector. Used by `make eval-run` so the ADK 11-criteria evaluator has something to score the same way across model profiles (Gemini-3-Flash vs Opus baseline). Larger, warehouse-backed golden sets are generated from dryfit via `make eval-dataset` and live in Langfuse.

parts.text: You are profiling a B2B SaaS warehouse for a seat-based collaboration product. The events table `events` has these event names with rough volumes over the last 90 days: `signed_up` (1200), `invited_teammate` (3400), `seat_assigned` (2900), `workspace_created` (1100), `subscription_started` (210), `feature_used` (54000), `seat_limit_reached` (180). Which single event is the strongest paid-conversion success signal, and name two leading product-usage signals that plausibly predict it? Answer concisely: success_event=<name>, then a short bulleted list of two predictive signals with one line of reasoning each.

success_event=subscription_started

- seat_limit_reached — accounts that hit their seat cap are demand-constrained and the most likely to upgrade to a paid plan.
- invited_teammate / seat_assigned growth — rising seat assignment within an account signals expanding team adoption, the leading indicator of seat-based monetization.
